# Tako

> Tako is a data intelligence platform. The Tako MCP server lets AI agents search a knowledge base of 100K+ curated charts, get grounded answers, fetch underlying source content, and run a multi-step Answer Agent.

## Documentation

- [MCP Server Setup](https://github.com/TakoData/tako-mcp): Connect to the hosted Tako MCP server
- [API Reference](https://tako.com/docs/): Full REST API documentation
- [Chart Gallery](https://tako.com/gallery): Browse example charts and visualizations
- [OpenAPI Spec](https://tako.com/openapi.yaml): Machine-readable API specification

## Quick Start

Connect your MCP client to `https://mcp.tako.com/mcp` with `Authorization: Bearer <TAKO_API_TOKEN>` (CLI/desktop), or via the server's OAuth flow (Claude.ai, ChatGPT).

The Answer Agent (`tako_agent`) is opt-in — off by default. Enable it by adding `?tools=agent` to the URL: `https://mcp.tako.com/mcp?tools=agent`.

## Capabilities

- Fast search over 100K+ curated charts and live data — economics, finance, demographics, sports, markets, weather — plus the live web on request (`tako_search`); the top result auto-renders as an interactive chart. Deep multi-step research is the opt-in Answer Agent (`tako_agent`, enable with `?tools=agent`).
- Get grounded, citation-backed prose answers from Tako's knowledge graph and/or the live web (`tako_answer`)
- Fetch the underlying data (CSV) or page text behind any result URL (`tako_contents`)
- Create an embeddable chart/card directly from your own structured data — timeseries, bar, table, financial boxes, and more (`tako_visualize`); the card auto-renders as an interactive chart.
- Run a multi-step Answer Agent for complex analytical questions (`tako_agent`; opt-in, enable with `?tools=agent`)
- Check API credit balance (`get_credit_balance`)
